name: Ayesha K.
quote: The Burns Road Zinger is crunchy all the way through and the garlic mayo is perfect. Arrived hot at midnight.

name: Hamza R.
quote: Grill Mix Platter fed four of us. Smoky tikka, soft naan and that green chutney — proper Karachi BBQ.

name: Sana M.
quote: Fire Wings live up to the name. Ordering was quick and the rider called before arriving.

name: Bilal A.
quote: Smoky Smash Beef has those crispy edges you only get when it's done right. Mint Margarita on the side is a must.

name: Fatima Z.
quote: Loved the Tikka Rice Bowl for a lighter dinner. Generous portion and the garlic sauce is addictive.

name: Usman T.
quote: Saddar Shawarma tastes exactly like the street stalls, only cleaner. Great value too.
